text.en: The clinic staff and veterinarians receive strong praise from long-term clients for their dedication, kindness, and clear communication. Pet owners frequently single out Dr. Franke, Dr. Choi, and receptionist Jessica for their attentive care and welcoming demeanor, though a single reviewer complained of rude treatment during an exam.

Reviewers report successful medical outcomes across routine checkups and complex procedures, including effective treatment for kitten infections, surgical interventions, and ongoing senior pet care. Long-standing clients who have visited the facility for decades express lasting confidence in the clinical competence of the veterinary doctors.

Most pet parents appreciate how patiently the team handles pets, successfully soothing nervous giant dogs and accommodating anxious cats during visits. However, one owner experienced friction when clinic staff appeared nervous around an agitated cat, indicating that pet temperament can occasionally impact the examination experience.

q.en: Is the clinic open for Saturday appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients mention scheduling Saturday morning appointments for routine examinations and urgent health issues.

q.en: How do reviewers describe the clinic's veterinary fees?

a.en: Most pet owners find the visit fees reasonable and under one hundred dollars, though one reviewer found the basic exam charge steep.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate large or anxious dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the veterinary team handled a nervous giant Anatolian Shepherd with patience and attentive care.

q.en: How long has North Valley Veterinary Clinic served pet owners?

a.en: Clients report bringing their companion animals to the clinic continuously since 1985, reflecting decades of consistent local care.
